prompt.en: Which of these is a mobility right of Canadian citizens?

options.en: The right to live and work in any province or territory
The right to set provincial tax rates

explanation.en: Canadian citizens may take up residence and pursue a livelihood anywhere in Canada, with limited exceptions set out in law.

source: Discover Canada — Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship

prompt.en: Which document is the highest law protecting rights and freedoms in Canada?

options.en: The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms
The British North America Act of 1931

explanation.en: The Charter, part of the Constitution, guarantees fundamental, democratic, mobility, legal, equality, and language rights.

source: Discover Canada — Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship

prompt.en: Serving on a jury when called is a responsibility of Canadian citizenship.

explanation.en: Citizenship comes with duties as well as rights. Those duties include obeying the law, serving on a jury if summoned, voting in elections, and helping others in the community.

source: Discover Canada — Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship
